summary: Samurai locate arrival selects Sam-loca, but its whole Lua loader is missing. Port the complete Sam-loca.lua fortress map, lit/nondiggable region, sixteen locked and eight closed doors, two fixed stairs, thirty-two class-selected objects, six traps, and source-ordered ninjas, wolves, canine, stalkers and samurai guards.

source.branch: Valid Samurai quest locate arrival reaches load_special for Sam-loca. Lua fills solid stone, sets mazelevel/hardfloor, places its centered 76x20 fortress map, lights the region, sets the source door states, creates up then down stairs, marks walls nondiggable, and runs object/trap/monster descriptors in source order.
callers: do.c goto_level -> mklev.c makelevel -> mkmaze.c makemaz -> sp_lev.c load_special -> dat/Sam-loca.lua. JS allmain deferred-goto -> do goto_level -> mklev makelevel/makemaz/load_special -> QUEST_LEVEL_LOADERS lacks Sam-loca.

Accepted wizcmds.c wiz_load_splua invokes load_special directly for the source-named program. Natural quest arrival and wizard travel converge on generation; no distinct Lua callback or extra program entry.
dependencies: Existing createSpecialLevelApi solidfill, level_flags mazelevel/hardfloor, array-form map, relative selection area, region, door, stair, non_diggable, object, trap and monster methods cover the program. No external helper or source contract edit identified.

The array-form map uses canonical mapFromRows centered placement with the exact 76x20 rows and wall, secret-door, ordinary-door and pool glyphs. Lua discards its returned placement; selection.area(0,0,75,19) is the existing canonical relative selection.

lspo_door positional forms read locked/closed mask and exact coordinates, then get_location_coord and sel_set_door. Source-fixed masks do not draw rnddoor; preserve both secret and ordinary door map context and descriptor order. The two stair positional forms use existing l_create_stairway and source trap removal/location semantics.

Object positional strings map through def_char_to_objclass: star selects gems, bracket armor, closing parenthesis weapons, opening parenthesis tools. Eight fixed positions per group go through canonical lspo_object and mkobj_at. Preserve source class and call order, not fixed object substitutes; no explicit tin, artifact name or alignment expression exists.

lspo_monster must preserve table id forms with peaceful=0 for ninjas/samurai, positional wolf forms with default peaceful handling, positional class d at (59,14), and one-string stalker forms with random coordinates. Existing class selection, parser gender and makemon state are reused, including stalker invisibility. No source result is replaced with a placeholder.

Lua consumes only selection.area results and ignores every descriptor result. Canonical internal coordinate, class and monster creation results remain source-owned dependencies; runtime validation must establish combined behavior before completion.

B199 owns the distinct Sam-goal program; C175 Rog-strt, C174 Rog-goal, C169/C170/B195 and the parked reports remain separate source units. Only an adjacent quest_levels import/function/key is proposed; no generic descriptor, alignment macro or non-species tin seam is touched.
